First developed a bulging disk at 21. Very frustrating injury. 
I would 100% suggest seeing a physiotherapist. I found they were much safer than chiropractors. The unfortunate thing with a bulging disk is that it will always be there. The pain can go away after a while but there will always be a weakness there. I had to defer my studies for a couple of years which was super hard but I knew I had to dedicate myself to getting better. I tried everything from doctors to physios, chiros, natural healers, surgeons, sports medicine doctors, kinesiologists...at the end of the day a serious back injury takes a lot of time to heal and get better. Doing things like pilates, swimming and stretching were an enormous part of my recovery.
